title: Felix and the Inheritance
author: Sable Eriksen
blurb: Casper Okonkwo, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
